## Design

### 2026-10-23 – 10:45-4:45

**6h**

10:45-4:45

- Added symbol, footprint, and 3d model libraries specifically for this project
- Added components for board
- Imported onto PCB Designer
- Assigned footprints
- Learned how to wire on two layers (if i had known this in week one maybe i wouldn't have crashed out over complex wiring)
- Learned how to import images to kicad (apparently i used reference images instead of silkscreen footprints in week 1)
- Learned how to make the 3d visualizer look pretty (wowie)
- Learned how to import custom 3d models for components
- This went by a lot faster than week 1, because I understood mostly what to do now
- Thought I was done then remembered that GNDs had to be wired
- Finalized Wiring (probably didn't update half of the images that i uploaded before that)
- Learned how to use vias
- Re uploaded everything to github
- Gonna code firmware next time and prepare for production (why didn't week 1 have this stuff in the tutorial, i could have used it), maybe even make a case if i have the time
